reviewed_adaptation.scope: Habitat-connectivity preference among already eligible riparian wetland restoration sites; distance to existing riparian habitat OR open water.
reviewed_adaptation.note: Human-adapted bands simplify conditional patch-area/proximity priorities. Middle .5 and outer .33 are reviewed scores, not source ecological limits. Negative values unknown; no water-supply pooling. Requires both habitat and open-water distance inputs plus eligibility mask.

source_relationship.direction: candidate sites farther than 120 m from extant riparian vegetation or open water are down-prioritised — proximity reduces habitat fragmentation and aids species recruitment into the restored site
source_relationship.note: Priority in a conditional spatial allocation sequence, not a universal ecological suitability threshold. Full source includes a separate scrub-cover preservation/restoration branch.

reviewed_correction.note: Remove source abs_max=120: source describes low priority, not unsuitable. Reviewed 0–90=1, >90–120=.5, >120=.33 lives in numeric policy as human habitat-connectivity preference. Requires eligible riparian wetland sites and distance to existing riparian habitat OR open water, not generic river proximity.

context.practice_as_described: Riparian wetland restoration prioritisation among already eligible sites, using proximity to existing riparian habitat or open water and contiguous patch area.

reported_values.meaning: conditional high/medium/low priorities; small or distant sites low, not excluded
